fields.placeholder: What it is, who it's for, and the one thing viewers should remember.
fields.value: Generative Loaders is a React library for AI interfaces: 46 animated loading states, including 16 text reveals, 18 inline activity indicators, and 12 image-generation placeholders. Its website currently displays 84K npm downloads (checked October 5, 2026; not unique users). Create a 20-second product film for the dark TV-style frame on the creator’s portfolio. Show the product animations large enough to understand at a small player size. Sequence: 0–3s “Make waiting worth watching.” revealed with Decode/Typewriter; 3–9s hero close-ups of Matrix, Orbit, Signal and an image reveal; 9–13s pull back to a wall of varied loaders, with “46 loaders. Text. Inline. Image.”; 13–16s a concise website selection-and-copy-code moment; 16–20s “84K npm downloads”, Generative Loaders, and generativeloaders.com. Animate the loader shapes and text; make the breadth visible. Use the supplied website screenshots as the visual source. Do not claim a working interaction or capability absent from the references.

fields.label: studio-notes
fields.placeholder: Must-haves, words to avoid, the line it should end on…
fields.value: Charcoal #171918, warm white #F2F0EB, muted gray #A4A7A2. Editorial motion design: oversized readable typography, precise easing, one focal idea per beat. Dark full-bleed backgrounds; remove white webpage canvases around isolated UI. No mascots, teal, neon, stock footage, flashing, or thumbnail zoom loops. Product motion is the hero. Keep text and code accurate. Silent-first; no voiceover. End on generativeloaders.com. Match the restrained type-led clarity of BINTEX and dark product staging of Open Sponsor.
